popCulture.description: Euripides' Corinth — Jason's betrayal and Medea's revenge — remains the West's most staged portrait of a wronged sorceress.

popCulture.title: Medea
popCulture.description: The Colchian who kills her children to wound Jason — Corinth fixes her forever as tragedy's most terrible mother.
